description: This Java class defines a custom ELResolver for resolving properties on XML DOM Nodes using XPath expressions, primarily for read-only property access within a Java EE Expression Language context.

classes.name: NodeELResolver
classes.description: A custom ELResolver that evaluates XPath expressions on DOM Nodes, supporting only read-only access.

methods.name: NodeELResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XPath object.

methods.name: getCommonPropertyType
methods.description: Returns String.class if the base object is resolvable, otherwise null.

methods.name: getFeatureDescriptors
methods.description: Returns null; no feature descriptors provided.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns Node.class if the base is resolvable, indicating the type of property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Evaluates an XPath expression on the Node base object and returns matching nodes or list of nodes.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the resolver is read-only.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws PropertyNotWritableException as the resolver is read-only.

methods.name: isResolvable
methods.description: Checks if the base object is a Node or NodeImpl.

methods.name: getXPathExpressionInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or compiles an XPathExpression from cache for a given XPath string.
